label: For "Healthcare Vendor Substitution Recommendation": Recommend alternative suppliers or items when supply, price, quality or contract risk requires substitution, ranking only options that clinical and biomedical teams have approved as equivalent. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Using embedding similarity for equivalence.
